The report describes two failures: (1) an interaction of two standardized stress variables with no predictive power and about 50% coverage, likely from a long history requirement; (2) an invalid submission because the hypothesis exceeded the word limit by two words.

The proposed hypothesis is a single-variable feature, not an interaction, so it sidesteps the first failure in structure. But it uses an expanding-history z-score ("exp"), which still carries a long history requirement and could still produce low coverage. It also doesn't address the weak predictive power in any explicit way.

On the word limit, the hypothesis is about 30 words. The limit isn't stated, so it is unclear whether this complies. The hypothesis has no explicit indication that it avoids the failure.

The evidence is unclear, and nothing explicitly addresses either failure.
